title: Rajko Mitić Stadium
visualBrief: Specific Rajko Mitić/Red Star stadium in the established2012–2013 reference configuration. Own native asymmetrical oval/retaining base, terracotta athletics track/neutral football field, continuous red-cream seating bank/pale radial aisles/low rim galleries, single western curved pale canopy with exposed supporting frame/rear posts and west hospitality strip, curved pale office/entrance frontage with red horizontal bands/visible red supports/brick lower face, four tall inward-facing light heads and neutral supported end display. Later track repaints/current branding, copied lettering/crests/advertisements/seat artwork/crowd, furnished hidden rooms and independent neighboring structures are excluded.
